l2_convergence_study.issue: Physical quantities (stress, displacement, reaction force) are in binary .xplt files. Need a parser to extract them. pyfebio package does not have read_xplt function. Attempted to add text datafile output but the datafile XML syntax is incorrect.
l2_convergence_study.what_we_have: All 3 meshes ran to NORMAL TERMINATION. Solver converged for all mesh densities. xplt file sizes scale correctly (83K → 578K → 2.3M). Iteration counts are stable (54 → 52). This is evidence of solver STABILITY across mesh densities but NOT yet evidence of PHYSICAL CONVERGENCE (need to compare actual stress/force values).
l2_convergence_study.what_we_need: Extract physical quantities from .xplt files. Options: (a) find correct FEBio datafile XML syntax for text output, (b) build an .xplt parser, (c) use FEBio Studio (not installed), (d) use the log file data (if FEBio prints stress/force to log).
l2_convergence_study.pre_registered_tolerance: Coarse vs Medium: <5% relative difference in reaction force. Medium vs Fine: <2%.
l2_convergence_study.l2_status: PARTIALLY COMPLETE — solver runs at all mesh densities but physical quantities not yet extracted
